original_failures.count_l1_pre: Count L1 after sampling, before commit
original_failures.count_final_pre: Count final slot before witness accept
original_failures.histogram_final_post: Histogram final slot after witness accept
original_failures.receive_expire_pre: Receiver first event before witness accept; retry after expiry
original_failures.receive_expire_post: Receiver first event after witness accept; retry after expiry
original_failures.confirm_withheld_pre: Sender confirmation before final event write, with withheld tail
original_failures.confirm_cross_post: Sender confirmation after witness accept, with second route

replica_modes: existing replica left by original failure
fresh initialized empty replica without witness anchor
datasets: All eight subsets of a synthetic three-user roster, conditioned on approved count=1 or histogram=(1,0,0,0).
logical_rule: Recovery interruption only advances the declared public clock. Model data, pending exact retry, budget, approved-output resources, receiver facts and final prefix remain unchanged. Successful RECOVER/DELIVERY_RECOVER is still required by the driver before business resumes.
runtime_assertions: Each recovery child actually exits at the named hook with code 96
All sender/receiver authority heads and images unchanged
Local image and optional anchor stay byte-identical to pre-recovery state before commit, or both match authority after commit
Incomplete or stale replica rejects business guard; current replica is not falsely required to reject
Business-dispatch and witness-write entry points guarded in recovery child
Separate diagnostic restore verifies R1-R8 and R10 where applicable against authority, never feeding storage into generator

relations.R12: Local recovery atomicity, optional anchor/current status, authority unchanged, stale guard and forbidden-dispatch checks
relations.existing_relations: Original profile R9/R10/R11 and operational restore checks retained; not every relation applies to every profile

scope_limits: Single specified original failure followed by six restore failures; not arbitrary interleavings
No concurrent writer or changing authority during recovery
No authority rollback or power loss; local SQLite files only
No TLS/network/physical timing or length privacy claim
No sender preparation or retention/cleanup transitions
No general induction or cryptographic/DP composition proof
replay: Rebuilds public observations/signing calls/final model state. Checks archived relation-hash bindings, dataset neighbors and public-view equality between replica modes. Does not repeat child exits or independently reconstruct DB projections.
